title: Pattern-Like M3 Common Definitions
description: Vocabulary introduced by the M3 daily-reading freeze. Anything unchanged from M0 is referenced by absolute $id from https://patternlike.app/contracts/m0/common.schema.json rather than restated here, so the frozen enums stay single-sourced. Normative sources: product platform spec v0.2 and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-09-m3-daily-reading-pipeline.md.

schemaVersion.description: M3 contract package version. M0 documents remain at 0.2.0 and are byte-frozen.

assemblyId.description: Opaque content-addressed assembly handle: 'asm_' + first 32 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of assemblyIdentityInputV1. Never a stable pseudonym: the preimage carries the day's facts, so the value changes daily.

cycleId.description: Opaque cycle handle: 'cyc_' + first 32 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of cycleIdentityV1. Names a physical encounter, not a scan.

cyclePassId.description: Opaque per-pass handle. Derived from the parent cycle identity plus pass_index.

readingRevision.description: Monotonic artifact revision within one user's local day. Revision 1 is the initial reading; a correction is revision 2 and supersedes revision 1.

commandGeneration.description: Which immutable generation command currently owns a reservation. A retry reuses its generation; a trusted replacement after terminal failure increments it. Distinct from readingRevision: a replaced command does not consume an artifact revision.

revisionReason.description: Why this revision exists. 'initial' requires revision 1 and no predecessor; every other value requires a predecessor. Deliberately excludes a content-release reason: activating a release does not retroactively revise published readings (spec section 7), so a reissue after a pointer move is a human safety_correction or defect_repair.

commandReplacementReason.description: Why a terminally failed command was replaced by the next generation. Replacement freezes a new command against the same reservation; it never mutates a retry's inputs.

passDirection.description: Sign of Swiss longitudinal speed at the exact pass. At a station-on-target tangent the outgoing station direction is used.

policyVersion.description: Opaque version of a named policy. Must change for any ranking, selection, rendering, fallback, validation, scan-grid, tolerance, or lookaround change that can alter output for otherwise identical inputs.

outputSchemaName.description: Pinned structured output schema for deterministic assembly. Defined by daily-reading.schema.json in this package.

assemblyPolicyId.description: The only assembly policy that exists in M3. Constrained-model editing is M5.

identityProfile.description: Domain separation tag inside a hash preimage. Versions the exact set of canonical bytes so a preimage change cannot silently reuse an id.

factClass.description: Calculated fact classes usable in editorial eligibility. Identical to the M0 content-release eligibility vocabulary, promoted to a named definition because M3 references it from three documents.

suppressedFeatureClass.description: Closed set emitted by apps/calc-stub/src/engine.ts buildUncertainty(). Closed rather than free-form because it enters a hash preimage.

timezoneSource.description: Provenance of users.timezone. Scheduled generation is withheld while the value is default_unconfirmed. A device update may refresh device_derived but never overwrites user_confirmed.

localeSource.description: Provenance of users.locale, on the same rules as timezoneSource. Locale selects the reviewed fallback and timing template, so it cannot stay an unowned server default.

eligibilityMode.description: A universal object must be publishable with zero calculated facts and unknown birth-time accuracy. Only daily_fallback objects may declare it.
